title: College ERP
subtitle: Modern College Management System
problem: Decentralized academic and administrative operations handling sensitive student and financial data lack strict role-based access control, scalability, and centralized security.
solution: A modern, secure, and scalable College ERP built with Next.js and Supabase for managing students, faculty, attendance, fees, academic marks, and institutional administration through strict RBAC.

architecture.overview: Modular Next.js architecture leveraging Server Components and Actions, backed by Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) to enforce data privacy and access control.

techStack.name: Next.js
techStack.reasonForChoice: Server Components and Server Actions provide an excellent backend layer while preserving a snappy client experience.

techStack.name: Supabase & PostgreSQL
techStack.reasonForChoice: PostgreSQL offers strong relational modeling for complex ERP relationships, while Supabase provides Auth and RLS.

techStack.name: TypeScript
techStack.reasonForChoice: Ensures type safety across the full stack.

challenges.title: Data Privacy and Role Based Access
challenges.detail: Students, teachers, and admins require strictly segregated access to attendance and marks data.
challenges.resolution: Implemented comprehensive Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) combined with PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS).

futureScope: Library, Hostel, and Transport Management modules.
Multi-College SaaS Management for handling tenant scaling.
lessonsLearned: Server-side authorization is non-negotiable for security.
Database schema relationships must be designed thoroughly before building complex UI forms.

performanceMetrics.impact: Data is protected at the database level.

voiceNarration.transcript: College ERP is a secure platform built with Next.js and Supabase for managing academic and administrative operations.

title: TravelFlow
subtitle: Complete Travel Booking Application
problem: Fragmented travel booking experiences requiring multiple distinct platforms for flights, hotels, trains, and insurance.
solution: A unified, full-stack travel booking platform with intelligent round-trip combinations, multi-city hotel search, and comprehensive train and insurance booking systems.

architecture.overview: React 19 single-page application utilizing Vite, consuming RESTful APIs powered by an Express.js backend connected to MongoDB.

techStack.name: Express.js
techStack.reasonForChoice: Lightweight API framework for routing requests.

techStack.name: MongoDB
techStack.reasonForChoice: Flexible NoSQL schema for handling complex and varied booking structures.

challenges.title: Smart Round-Trip Combinations
challenges.detail: Calculating the best outbound and return flight combinations across varying airlines and times dynamically.
challenges.resolution: Engineered a combination algorithm that analyzes outbound/return arrays to calculate optimal price and total duration metrics.

futureScope: Razorpay integration for online payment checkout.
lessonsLearned: Structuring complex nested API data correctly simplifies frontend state management.

voiceNarration.transcript: TravelFlow is a unified, full-stack travel booking platform built with React, Express, and MongoDB.

title: Technovate Website
subtitle: Technical Innovation Club Platform
problem: Club activities, event registrations, and announcements are often scattered across forms, social media, and disparate communication channels.
solution: A centralized, modern web platform for showcasing the club's activities, managing events and teams, and providing an authenticated student dashboard.

architecture.overview: Modular Next.js 14 App Router application structuring public pages, authenticated areas, member dashboards, and secure admin routes.

techStack.name: Next.js 14
techStack.reasonForChoice: Optimal performance with App Router and server components.

techStack.name: Tailwind CSS
techStack.reasonForChoice: Utility-first styling for creating responsive and modern interfaces.

challenges.title: Fragmented Club Data
challenges.detail: Data related to members, events, and projects was previously tracked in spreadsheets.
challenges.resolution: Designed a cohesive schema for managing entities in a dedicated database.

futureScope: Event registration system with ticket generation.
lessonsLearned: Modular route grouping in Next.js (e.g. (auth), (dashboard)) significantly enhances project organization.

voiceNarration.transcript: Technovate is a centralized platform for the Technical Innovation Club, built with Next.js 14.
